biography_summary: 布霍里·坎索（Bukhoree Kamsoh，公开来源中亦拼作 Bukhoree Kamso、Bukhori Lamso）为泰国南部武装组织 Runda Kumpulan Kecil（RKK，小巡逻队组织，org_id=TH-MIL-009）的人物。据英文维基百科记载，在其领导下，该组织主要活动于宋卡府南部的乍纳 (Chana)、贴帕 (Thepha)、那他威 (Na Thawi)、沙拜约 (Saba Yoi) 四县；泰文维基百科相关脚注亦有相同记载。Bangkok Post 2019年8月报道以 "Bukhori Lamso" 之名称其为武装组织重要领导人，并记载其时出现于宋卡府贴帕县。其出生日期、性别、国籍、个人经历等均无公开可查记载；2019年8月之后关于其身份与现状的公开信息缺乏。

quotes.title: Runda Kumpulan Kecil - Wikipedia (EN)
quotes.text: Under Bukhoree Kamsoh the RKK group was mainly active in the southern part of Songkhla, in the 4 districts, namely Chana, Thepha, Na Thawi, and Saba Yoi.

quotes.title: Former RKK leader Abdultore Kaso killed - Bangkok Post (2019-08-08)
quotes.text: About three days before Abdultore was killed, key insurgent group leader Bukhori Lamso was spotted in Thepha district, according to an intelligence source.
